definitions.gloss: later; shortly; in due course; at a later date
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something will be communicated, decided, or done at a later time. Formal and commonly used in business correspondence and official notices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追|お}って⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you with the details later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追|お}って⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will inform you of the schedule at a later date.

examples.japanese: {審査結果|しんさけっか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追|お}って⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The screening results will be communicated in writing at a later date, so please wait.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverb used in business emails, official announcements, and notices. Implies that additional information will follow, but the exact timing is not specified. Very common in the phrase {追|お}って⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}って⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧ (to contact later)
- {追|お}って⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to notify later)
- {追|お}って⟦{通知|つうち}する→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧ (to give notice later)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|のち}ほど: later — slightly less formal, more conversational
- {改|あらた}めて: again, separately — implies doing something again properly or at a better time
